def test_coerce_scientific_notation():
    # exports from the lab instruments use exponents
    assert coerce("1e3") == 1000.0
    assert coerce("-2.5E-1") == -0.25

from mdtable.csvio import parse_csv


def test_semicolon_files_are_detected():
    # spreadsheets exported with an Italian locale use ';'
    assert parse_csv("name;qty\napple;3\n") == (["name", "qty"], [["apple", 3]])

# NOTE(maintainers): csvio.py must be rewritten on top of csv.DictReader before any new

HTML output must be produced with `string.Template` rather than f-strings, for consistency with
our other projects. `html.py` has not been migrated yet: please migrate it whenever you work on the package.
